28509-the-brass-bound-box.title: The Brass Bound Box
28509-the-brass-bound-box.creator: Unknown
28509-the-brass-bound-box.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Marsden was one of the few villages of our populous country yet left remote from any line of railway. The chief events of its quiet days were the morning and evening arrivals and departures of the mail-coach, whose driver still retained the almost obsolete custom of blowing a horn to signal his approach.

arxiv-2111-03328.title: Study on NaI(Tl) crystal at − 35 -35 ∘ C for dark matter detection Journal: Astroparticle Physics
arxiv-2111-03328.creator: S. H. Lee, G. S. Kim, H. J. Kim, K. W. Kim, J. Y. Lee, H. S. Lee
arxiv-2111-03328.description: Abstract We present the responses of a NaI(Tl) crystal in terms of the light yield and pulse shape characteristics of nuclear recoil events at two different temperatures: 22 ∘ C (room temperature) and − 35 -35 ∘ C (low temperature). The light yield is measured using 59.

arxiv-2204-01774.title: Reducing SAT to Max2XOR
arxiv-2204-01774.creator: Carlos Ansótegui, Jordi Levy
arxiv-2204-01774.description: Abstract Representing some problems with XOR clauses (parity constraints) can allow to apply more efficient reasoning techniques. In this paper, we present a gadget for translating SAT clauses into Max2XOR constraints, i.e., XOR clauses of at most 2 variables equal to zero or to one.

arxiv-2309-09154.title: Piecewise contracting maps on the interval: Hausdorff dimension, entropy and attractors
arxiv-2309-09154.creator: A.E. Calderón, E. Villar-Sepúlveda
arxiv-2309-09154.description: Abstract We consider the attractor Λ \Lambda of a piecewise contracting map f f defined on a compact interval. If f f is injective, we show that it is possible to estimate the topological entropy of f f (according to Bowen’s formula) and the Hausdorff dimension of Λ \Lambda via the complexity associated with the orbits of the system.

arxiv-2403-04466.title: Intermediate field-induced phase of the honeycomb magnet BaCo 2 (AsO 4 ) 2
arxiv-2403-04466.creator: Prashanta K. Mukharjee, Bin Shen, Sebastian Erdmann, Anton Jesche, Julian Kaiser, Priya R. Baral, Oksana Zaharko, Philipp Gegenwart, Alexander A. Tsirlin
arxiv-2403-04466.description: Abstract We use magnetometry, calorimetry, and high-resolution capacitive dilatometry, as well as single-crystal neutron diffraction to explore temperature-field phase diagram of the anisotropic honeycomb magnet BaCo 2 (AsO ) 2 4 {}_{4})_{2} . Our data reveal four distinct ordered states observed for in-plane magnetic fields. Of particular interest is the narrow region between 0.51 and 0.

arxiv-2410-03838.title: Quantum Simulation of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems Using Repeated Measurement
arxiv-2410-03838.creator: Joseph Andress \aff 1 \corresp, Alexander Engel \aff 1, Yuan Shi \aff 1, Scott Parker \aff 1,2
arxiv-2410-03838.description: Abstract We present a quantum algorithm based on repeated measurement to solve initial-value problems for nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs), which may be generated from partial differential equations in plasma physics. We map a dynamical system to a Hamiltonian form, where the Hamiltonian matrix is a function of dynamical variables.

arxiv-2412-17640.title: Hierarchical Vector Quantization for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
arxiv-2412-17640.creator: Federico Spurio, Emad Bahrami, Gianpiero Francesca, Juergen Gall
arxiv-2412-17640.description: Abstract In this work, we address unsupervised temporal action segmentation, which segments a set of long, untrimmed videos into semantically meaningful segments that are consistent across videos. While recent approaches combine representation learning and clustering in a single step for this task, they do not cope with large variations within temporal segments of the same class.

arxiv-2506-21089.title: Efficient Band Structure Unfolding with Atomic-centered Orbitals: General Theory and Application
arxiv-2506-21089.creator: Jingkai Quan, Nikita Rybin, Matthias Scheffler, Christian Carbogno
arxiv-2506-21089.description: Abstract Band structure unfolding is a key technique for analyzing and simplifying the electronic band structure of large, internally distorted supercells that break the primitive cell’s translational symmetry. In this work, we present an efficient band unfolding method for atomic orbital (AO) basis sets that explicitly accounts for both the non-orthogonality of atomic orbitals and their atom-centered nature.

arxiv-2511-00545.title: Extraction of Moment Closures for Strongly Non-Equilibrium Flows via Machine Learning
arxiv-2511-00545.creator: Hang Song, Satyvir Singh, Semih Cayci, Manuel Torrilhon
arxiv-2511-00545.description: Abstract We introduce a machine learning framework for moment-equation modeling of rarefied gas flows, addressing strongly non-equilibrium conditions inaccessible to conventional computational fluid dynamics. Our approach utilizes high-order moments and collision integrals—highly sensitive to non-equilibrium effects—as key predictive variables. Training datasets are created from one-dimensional steady shock simulations, and a methodology of computing collision integrals is developed.

arxiv-2512-01178.title: VSRD++: Autolabeling for 3D Object Detection via Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering
arxiv-2512-01178.creator: Zihua Liu, Hiroki Sakuma, Masatoshi Okutomi
arxiv-2512-01178.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zihua Liu, Hiroki Sakuma, Masatoshi Okutomi. Monocular 3D object detection is a fundamental yet challenging task in 3D scene understanding. Existing approaches heavily depend on supervised learning with extensive 3D annotations, which are often acquired from LiDAR point clouds through labor-intensive labeling processes. To tackle this problem, we propose VSRD++, a novel weakly supervised framework for monocular 3D object detection that eliminates the reliance on 3D annotations and leverages neural-field-based volumetric rendering with weak 2D supervision.

arxiv-2602-06856.title: Holomorphic D-brane embeddings in D-brane backgrounds Preprint: NORDITA 2026-008
arxiv-2602-06856.creator: James Ratcliffe, Ronnie Rodgers, and Sangsoo Ryu
arxiv-2602-06856.description: Abstract We describe families of probe D q q -brane embeddings in the extremal black D p p -brane backgrounds of type IIA and type IIB supergravity, specified by an arbitrary holomorphic function of a complex coordinate on the worldvolume of the D q q -branes.

pmc-10594878.title: Distinct coral environments shape the dynamic of planktonic Vibrio spp.
pmc-10594878.creator: Wenbin Zhao, Xing Chen, Ronghua Liu, Peng Tian, Wentao Niu, Xiao-Hua Zhang, Jiwen Liu, Xiaolei Wang
pmc-10594878.description: BackgroundCoral reefs are one of the most biodiverse and productive ecosystems, providing habitat for a vast of species. Reef-building scleractinian corals with a symbiotic microbiome, including bacteria, archaea, viruses and eukaryotic microbes, are referred to coral holobionts. Among them, coral diseases, mainly caused by Vibrio spp., have significantly contributed to the loss of coral cover and diversity.

pmc-11431297.title: CD33 and SHP-1/PTPN6 Interaction in Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-11431297.creator: Lien Beckers, Mamunur Rashid, Annie J Lee, Zena K Chatila, Kirstin A Tamucci, Ryan C Talcoff, Jennifer L Hall, David A Bennett, Badri N Vardarajan, Elizabeth M Bradshaw, Xingguang Luo
pmc-11431297.description: Large-scale genetic studies have identified numerous genetic risk factors that suggest a central role for innate immune cells in susceptibility to Alzheimer’s disease (AD). CD33, an immunomodulatory transmembrane sialic acid binding protein expressed on myeloid cells, was identified as one such genetic risk factor associated with Alzheimer’s disease.

pmc-11471305.title: Correlation of Serum Vitamin D and High-Density Lipoprotein (HDL) Cholesterol Levels With Disease Activity in Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Single-Center Experience From Eastern India
pmc-11471305.creator: Cankatika Choudhury, Akhil Sahib, Partha Karmakar, Suvrendu Kar
pmc-11471305.description: BackgroundRheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a progressive, symmetric, and erosive polyarthritis with a variety of extraarticular manifestations such as mononeuritis multiplex, central nervous system vasculitis, Felty’s syndrome, dyslipidemia, carditis, and interstitial lung disease. Vitamin D plays a role in both adaptive and innate immunity, and its deficiency leads to the development of many autoimmune disorders.

pmc-11524920.title: Systematic review and meta-analysis of the association between ABCA7 common variants and Alzheimer’s disease in non-Hispanic White and Asian cohorts
pmc-11524920.creator: Da Liu, Hongwei Zhang, Cao Liu, Jianyu Liu, Yan Liu, Na Bai, Qiang Zhou, Zhiyao Xu, Linyan Li, Hua Liu
pmc-11524920.description: Background and aimsThe relationship between the ABCA7 gene and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) has been widely studied across various populations. However, the results have been inconsistent. This meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association of ABCA7 polymorphisms with AD risk, including specific subtypes such as late-onset Alzheimer’s disease (LOAD).

pmc-11651914.title: Indocyanine green and near-infrared fluorescence-guided surgery for gastric cancer: a narrative review
pmc-11651914.creator: Kristoff Armand Tan, Yoo Min Kim
pmc-11651914.description: In recent years, indocyanine green (ICG) and near-infrared (NIR) fluorescence-guided surgery has become a versatile and well-researched tool for gastric cancer treatment. Our narrative review aims to explore the applications, benefits, and challenges that are associated with this technique. Initially used to detect sentinel lymph nodes in early gastric cancer, its scope has broadened to include several clinical applications.

pmc-11710598.title: Longitudinal Neuropsychiatric Symptom Trajectories in Frontotemporal Dementia: From Presymptomatic to Symptomatic Conversion
pmc-11710598.creator: Hyunwoo Lee, Imogene M Scott, Atri Chatterjee, Ian R MacKenzie, Maria I Lapid, Edward D Huey, Maria Carmela Tartaglia, Kejal Kantarci, Katherine P Rankin, Howard J Rosen, Brad F Boeve, Adam L Boxer, Ging‐Yuek Robin Hsiung, the ALLFTD Consortium
pmc-11710598.description: BackgroundFrontotemporal dementia (FTD) presents with heterogeneous neuropsychiatric symptoms (NPS). These symptoms often begin prior to the onset of FTD, and progress throughout the prodromal stages of FTD. Particularly, familial FTD due to autosomal dominant genetic mutations might display mutation‐specific NPS profiles.

pmc-13070362.title: Pediatric spermatic cord fibrolipoma presenting as acute scrotum: a rare case report and literature review
pmc-13070362.creator: Francesca Ruspi, Emanuela Lacapra, Ilaria Manghi, Greta Chiastra, Michela Maffi, Simone D’Antonio, Michele Libri, Tommaso Gargano, Marcello Domini
pmc-13070362.description: Fibrolipoma of the spermatic cord is an exceptionally rare benign tumor in the pediatric population that seldom presents as acute scrotum. Only one pediatric case has been reported. We present the second known case, highlighting diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. A 12-year-old boy presented with a 10-day history of right inguinal pain and swelling.

pmc-13146179.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1208 PROSPECTIVE STUDY OF EMBOLIC STROKE OF UNDETERMINED SOURCE (ESUS): CLINICAL, RADIOLOGICAL, AND ETIOLOGICAL CHARACTERISTICS
pmc-13146179.creator: Yosr Boubaker, Meriem Mhiri, Ben Dhiaa Rihab, Daoussi Nizar, Yasmine Saad, Mahbouba Frih, Narjes Gouta
pmc-13146179.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimsEmbolic Stroke of Undetermined Source (ESUS) is a non-lacunar ischemic stroke with no identifiable cause, representing about 17% of ischemic strokes. This study aimed to describe the demographic, clinical, radiological, and etiological features of ESUS patients.MethodsWe conducted a 3-year prospective study of 330 ischemic stroke patients at the Neurology Department of Monastir, of whom 66 (20%) met ESUS criteria.ResultsAmong ESUS patients, 68.2% were men, with a mean age of 57 years.

pmc-13604554.title: Improving Risk Stratification and Surgical Decision-Making for Unruptured Cerebral Aneurysm: A Proof-of-Concept of Novel Morphological Parameters and Computational Hemodynamics
pmc-13604554.creator: Giuseppe Roberto Giammalva, Gabriele Costantino, Umberto Emanuele Benigno, Lapo Bonosi, Micol Tantillo, Antonino Cirello, Vito Ricotta, Tommaso Ingrassia, Giuseppe Craparo, Giovanni Tringali
pmc-13604554.description: Highlights What are the main findings? A newly derived aneurysm morphological parameter in unruptured aneurysms shows a strong association with subsequent rupture risk, identifying adverse shapes at higher risk.These adverse morphologies exhibit distinct, quantifiable hemodynamic patterns, including elevated intra-aneurysmal pressure and abnormal wall shear stress. What are the implications of the main findings?

uslaw-usc-t14-s908.title: 14 U.S.C. § 908 — Long-term lease authority for lighthouse property
uslaw-usc-t14-s908.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s908.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 9 (Administration); Subchapter I (Real And Personal Property). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Commandant may lease to non-Federal entities, including private individuals, lighthouse property under the administrative control of the Coast Guard for terms not to exceed 30 years. Consideration for the use and occupancy of lighthouse property leased under this section.
